headline: Quarry Chemicals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Quarry Chemicals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Quarry Chemicals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Quarry Chemicals reported revenue growth of 11% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Data breach at Quarry Chemicals exposes customer records
body: Quarry Chemicals disclosed unauthorized access to systems holding customer records. Regulators have been notified and affected customers are being contacted.

headline: Quarry Chemicals opens new production line in Pune
body: Quarry Chemicals commissioned a new line at its Pune site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Quarry Chemicals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Quarry Chemicals reported revenue growth of 6% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Quarry Chemicals labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Quarry Chemicals. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.

headline: Quarry Chemicals executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Quarry Chemicals as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.
